<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}

Bulk version of `/business/parcels/create/`. `parcels` is an array of up to **100** lines (same fields as the single create: `boxid`, `sizeid`, `recipientname`, `recipientphone`, `recipientemail`, optional `parceldescription`). Each line is validated and created independently; the response `results` array carries one entry per input line (`index`, `statuscode`, `statusmessage`, and on success `parceldetailid`, `parcelreferencenumber`, `boxlockernumber`). The wallet is debited **only** for parcels that were actually created; a failed line does not roll back the others. Overall `statuscode` is `00` when at least one parcel was created, otherwise `99`.
